Clients will be fairly busy with glamsterdam things the next couple weeks. They will barely have enough time to get this stuff done by the 28th. talked to prysm team, Jun from our team seems interested in taking lead on focil stuff. terence's old pr needs to be rewritten as it was from a year ago and forkchoice has changed since then. Even if we do join it maybe unlikely to include all the cfied eips... perhaps like 8015 can be vibe coded in 😅 Do we know how many clients have a fairly updated FOCIL branch? Initial plan looks reasonable, at least to me ( modulo this question) I would say 3, as there are 3 clients in focil-devnet-1. But there is a problem with lighthouse iirc. i think our focil was mostly fine, but mehdi is away. i can start looking at the CFI's, seems like we're probably ok assuming that our focil was ok on devnet and theres no major changes to that
